analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported robust financial performance for H1 FY26, with revenue reaching Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA at Rs. 13.43 crores, and PAT at Rs. 7.20 crores. Management highlighted expanded distribution footprints across major online and modern trade platforms, alongside new product initiatives including Soya Chunks and a planned vertical for puja and devotional items under the brand Neihaa Narayan.

guidance.claim: Management stated that H2 will be better than H1 in terms of margin and revenue.
guidance.quote: So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

guidance.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 to 2029.
guidance.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake according to the Indian Market Research Bureau.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the cart value for oil, ghee, and other products is 15% to 20%.
demand_outlook.quote: And oil and ghee and other products, cart value will be 15% to 20%; margins will be 18% to 22%.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading, and distribution of puja articles and devotional goods.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are not putting heavy capex in Soya Chunks and are planning it with very low capex.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we are not putting any heavy CAPEX in that. With the very low CAPEX we are planning it, only with the packaging material so that there will not be any hit.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai on July 28, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: Rights Shares were issued on October 10, 2024 to enhance the capital structure.
capex_expansion.quote: Rights Shares issued on 10th Oct, 2024 to enhance capital structure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched its new edible oil production plant and commenced commercial production on 10th May 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: and we launched our edible oil on 10th May 2025 and it started its commercial production on 10th May 2025.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY26 revenue stood at Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA at Rs. 13.43 crore, and PAT at Rs. 7.20 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue stood at Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA at Rs. 13.43 crore and PAT at Rs. 7.20 crore.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY26 EBITDA margin was 17.05% and PAT margin was 9.14%.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Total monthly spending on media channels is Rs. 5-6 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY26 EBITDA margin stood at 17.05%.
H1 FY26 Profit margin stood at 9.14%.
Management reported that margins for oil, ghee, and other products are between 18% and 22%.
margins_costs.quote: And oil and ghee and other products, cart value will be 15% to 20%; margins will be 18% to 22%.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that net profit decreased due to the new plant commencement and claiming six months of depreciation.
margins_costs.quote: Still the one thing I want to focus and just give the clarity on that. Our PAT has been decreased. See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

orders_capacity.claim: For Spices, installed capacity is 3,600 tons and 2,637 tons were utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: For Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and 12,650 tons were utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: And when it comes to Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: For Oil, installed capacity is 7,200 tons and 720 tons were utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to Oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons and we have utilized 720 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for spices and masalas is 3,600 tons per annum with a current utilization of about 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons per annum with a utilization of 12,650 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for oil is 7,200 tons per annum, but the plant is yet to be commercialized.
orders_capacity.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

capital_allocation.claim: Management specified that the objects of the rights issue included INR864.02 lakhs for the oil plant, INR1.90 crores for repayment of unsecured loans, INR10 crores for working capital, and INR4 crores for general corporate purposes.
capital_allocation.quote: our main objects of the rights issue was to for the oil plant, which is around INR8.64 crores, sorry, 864.02 lakhs, that is INR8 crores 64 lakhs change and repayment of unsecured loans, which is about INR1.90 crores and for working capital requirement, it is around INR10 crores and for general corporate purpose, it is around INR4 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that going to a new state requires a lot of budget on advertisement and takes a lot of time for placement.
risks_headwinds.quote: And second thing is, we have to put a lot of budget on the advertisement, if you go for the new state.

management_commitments.claim: The company is launching the new puja and devotional products vertical in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to install plant capacity for Soya Chunks after 2 quarters.
management_commitments.quote: Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to target export market expansion in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Definitely. But in FY '27. Next year, we will plan for the expansion.

management_commitments.claim: Srivari Spices & Foods is planning its next growth chapter with the launch of a new business vertical focusing on manufacturing, trading, and dealing of puja devotional articles, goods, festival-related items, and services under the brand name 'Neihaa Narayan'.
management_commitments.quote: Srivari Spices & Foods is planning its next growth chapter with the launch of a new business vertical

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that all oil products will be placed in complete marketplaces by the month end.
management_commitments.quote: All the oil product will be placed in the complete marketplaces.

management_commitments.claim: Management targeted reaching deliveries of 300 deliveries per day within a six-month timeframe.
management_commitments.quote: within the six months of time frame, in the two quarters, we are targeting per day targeting deliveries of 300 deliveries.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that exports are planned to start in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: definitely we are the second, H2, we are going to start the export.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
